51600776.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant SARS-CoV-2 main protease expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 expression cells assessed as dissociation constant measured for 60 secs by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.7. Surface pla: SPR assay was performed on Biacore T200 (Cytiva) at room temperature. The CM5 chip (Cytiva) was utilized to couple the target protein. Before coupling, the chip channel was activated with 1-ethyl-3-(3-dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide (EDC, GE Healthcare) and N-hydroxysuccinimide (NHS, GE Healthcare) at a flow rate of 10 μL/min for 60 s. After that, the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro protein was diluted with 10 mmol/L sodium acetate buffer (pH 4.0) to about 50 mg/mL. The flow rate for SARS-CoV-2 Mpro protein solution was 10 μL/min, and the injection time lasted for 120 s. The protein coupling volume of the channel was ~17000 RU. The channel was sealed with ethanolamine at a flow rate of 10 μL/min for 120 s. Mei derivatives were dissolved in 400 μM in 100 % DMSO and diluted 20-fold with the running buffer. Then, further dilution with a 2-fold gradient by the running buffer resulted in a concentration gradient ranging from 20 μM to 0.156 μM. The running buffer constitutes of phosphate buffer saline (PBS-P+, Cytiva) containing 5 % dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO; Sigma-Aldrich). Mei derivative or Nirmatrelvir solutions were passed through the chip coupled with Mpro from low concentration to high concentration. After each run, the chip was regenerated with aqueous NaOH solution at the flow rate of 30 μL/min for 60 s. Molecular weight adjustment and solvent correction were used to exclude non-specific binding. Data was analyzed with Biacore T200 Evaluation Software.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. The binding affinity between Mei derivatives with the recombinant SARS-CoV-2 Mpro in SPR assay.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 sensorgram data: Nirmatrelvir: KD=0.13 ± 0.1 μM; S5-20: KD=0.7 ± 0.39 μM; S5-27: KD=1.27 ± 0.44 μM; S5-28: KD=16.75 ± 8.8 μM. Concentrations tested: 20, 10, 5, 2.5, 1.25, 0.625, 0.3125, 0.156 μM. Time axis: -60 to 180 sec (Nirmatrelvir) or -60 to 120 sec (S5-20, S5-27, S5-28).
original_paragraph.Results section - 2.4. Mei binds to SARS: As shown in Fig. 4, S5-20, S5-27 and S5-28 exhibited superior binding affinity to Mpro, with KD values of 0.7, 1.27 and 16.75 μM respectively, which are consistent with those of enzymatic inhibitory activity.
